description: This file contains unit tests for the EventBusAuthenticationService class, verifying its behavior with different authentication scenarios using Vert.x and JUnit.

classes.name: EventBusAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the EventBusAuthenticationService functionality.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Vert.x and configures token helpers before all tests run.

methods.name: unregisterAuthRequestConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters the message consumer to clean up after tests.

methods.name: testAuthenticateSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful authentication flow where a token is correctly received.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailureNoHandler
methods.description: Tests failure scenario when no handler is registered for authentication requests.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailureValidStatusCode
methods.description: Tests failure scenario when the event bus replies with an unauthorized status code.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailureInvalidStatusCode
methods.description: Tests failure scenario when the event bus replies with an unexpected status code.

methods.name: createTestToken
methods.description: Generates a test token using the signing helper.
